events.title: Recovery proposed
events.detail: Checkout and storefront failures are caused by payments' strict_currency_validation rejecting legacy currency strings. Inventory and ledger are healthy, indicating the issue is isolated to payments. The current compatibility advisory permits rollback to payments v2.3, which predates ledger schema 2. The advisory explicitly allows rollback to v2.3, and no newer schema advisory has superseded it. The flag-only mitigation is blocked due to lack of updated safety advisory. Rollback to v2.3 is therefore the only supported action permitted by current policy. The full dependency chain shows that checkout and storefront depend on payments, and their failures propagate through the chain. A rollback to v2.3 will restore legacy currency support and resolve the validation error. The action is justified by the compatibility advisory and the symptom evidence. Downstream services (storefront, checkout) will be affected, but inventory and ledger remain healthy, indicating no broader impact. Rollback is the only action explicitly allowed by policy and is compatible with current ledger schema 1.
